# Weak-password pattern analysis (auto-generated by run_pipeline.py)

Dataset: 30,000 unique synthetic passwords; class counts weak = 15,291, medium = 5,668, strong = 9,041.

## Model performance (held-out test set)

| model | accuracy | macro-P | macro-R | macro-F1 | CV macro-F1 (mean ± std) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HistGradientBoosting | 0.9647 | 0.9502 | 0.9591 | 0.9545 | 0.9533 ± 0.0023 |
| RandomForest | 0.9573 | 0.9465 | 0.9407 | 0.9435 | 0.9461 ± 0.0028 |
| LogisticRegression | 0.9348 | 0.9116 | 0.9313 | 0.9194 | 0.9209 ± 0.0021 |
| Baseline_pool_entropy | 0.4768 | 0.5737 | 0.5130 | 0.4282 | — |
| Baseline_LUDS_meter | 0.4505 | 0.4621 | 0.4315 | 0.4167 | — |

Best learned model: **HistGradientBoosting**.

Top RandomForest impurity importances: `pool_entropy_bits` (0.116), `class_transitions` (0.094), `dict_coverage` (0.092), `shannon_total_bits` (0.091), `length` (0.074), `n_symbol` (0.071).

Logistic-regression coefficients pushing towards **weak** (standardised features): `dict_coverage` (+12.59), `has_year` (+2.79), `unique_char_ratio` (+2.74), `longest_keyboard_run` (+2.32), `shannon_total_bits` (+1.98); pushing away from weak: `shannon_entropy` (-5.71), `has_dict_word` (-4.31), `pool_entropy_bits` (-3.63), `n_dict_words` (-3.46), `n_digit` (-1.12).

Pattern types in the labeler's cheapest decomposition of weak passwords: dictionary 78.5%, bruteforce 71.3%, year 24.3%, spatial 8.3%, date 5.6%, repeat 3.5%, sequence 2.9%.

## Where a composition-rule (LUDS) meter is fooled

5,230 passwords (34.2% of all weak passwords) are rated **strong** by the LUDS meter but are weak under the pattern-aware labeler. Examples:

| password | family | guess bits | decomposition |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hard&maria98$` | mangled | 38.7 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + bruteforce |
| `PinK#michael` | word_combo | 17.1 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary |
| `TigerPeter1973` | word_combo | 22.2 | dictionary + dictionary + year |
| `peach#Emily2019` | mangled | 26.3 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + year |
| `Maya@09-09-03*` | name_date | 37.6 | dictionary + bruteforce + date + bruteforce |
| `pearl Ethan92` | word_combo | 35.7 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + bruteforce |
| `)(*&^%$xsw254321` | keyboard | 26.5 | spatial + spatial + dictionary |
| `Zom8ie!emily1%` | mangled | 34.0 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + bruteforce |
| `l4dder!BUTTER9` | mangled | 32.0 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + bruteforce |
| `horsep4nda2008%` | mangled | 30.6 | dictionary + dictionary + year + bruteforce |
| `n37w0rk&Queen1994` | mangled | 32.7 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + year |
| `Mountain+Nora` | word_combo | 23.2 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary |
| `River@Magic2009` | word_combo | 29.2 | dictionary + bruteforce + dictionary + year |
| `Secret421*` | word_digits | 33.2 | dictionary + bruteforce |
| `flow3R!!` | leet | 21.7 | dictionary + bruteforce |
